decisions.reason: The yogurt won an award and sits close to the core yogurt line, so it costs little to carry and its early signals are positive.
The flavored cheese is newly launched and featured on the home page, and its value is still uncertain while keeping it costs little, so the option is worth holding.
The semi-hard cheese wheel is close to the established offer and cheap to carry, with no negative evidence so far.
The spicy cheese has only a bare mention and its uncertainty has not resolved, but the firm runs several parallel cheese options, so it is kept with moderate risk of being dropped.
The mild soft cheese was launched to round out the new range and is too new to judge, so the low-cost option is kept.
Washed-rind soft cheese is a niche item with limited evidence and overlaps with the other new cheeses, but it is still kept while uncertainty lasts.
